text_blocks.snippet: PCR tests are generally more accurate than rapid antigen tests for COVID-19, but rapid tests offer faster results and are often more convenient. PCR tests are typically processed in a lab and are highly sensitive, meaning they can detect even very low levels of the virus. Rapid tests, also known as antigen tests, can be performed at home or in other settings and provide results within minutes.
